dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description:
For {@link UiSdlFilterPanel}, this field has to be assigned the value that matches the name of
the field being filtered on in the {@link FetchFilterSpec} of a {@link FetchSpec}.
For example, you have a {@link UiSdlDataGrid} that displays instances of TypeA. And you have a
UiSdlFilterPanel that has a SDLSelectField corresponding to a field on TypeA. The `fieldName` for
that instance of SDLSelectField has to match the name of the corresponding field on TypeA.

If you have a another SDLSelectField which is a reference field on TypeA, think about how you
would filter on that reference field in a fetch call. If your filter spec will be something like
`Filter.eq('someField.anotherField.id', 'someValue')`, the fieldName for that SDLSelectField will
have to be `someField.anotherField.id`.
This naming convention is important to make sure the grid can filter correctly based on the
selected value(s).

Note: fieldName has to be unique among the list of fieldNames in a UiSdlFilterPanel.

label.description: The label that should appear above the field.

hintText.description: The hint text to be shown below the field.

required.description: Whether or not this field is required.

disabled.description: Whether the field should be disabled.

placeholder.description: The placeholder text for a field.

dataSpec.description:
The field could also have a dataSpec. For example, a dropdown select could be backed by
a collection of countries. The data for this dataSpec should be in 'fieldCollection'.

fieldCollection.description:
Holds the data that will populate field collection.
For example, the options in a drop down.

dataPropSpecs.description:
Descriptors for how to obtain the value for a prop from data.
Specifies the path to the data and the prop to populate.

value.description: The current value of the field.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the field, if any.

invalid.description: Whether the value in the input is not acceptable as a valid value.

componentRef.description: The component to render in the field.

fieldRefComponents.description: A mapping of field name to ref component.

title: The data spec setting for a form field.  Represents the configurable options for a single form field.
name: UiSdlFormFieldDataSpecSetting
